tooltip.relicweave.aetherforged.perk: Vestige-attuned: armor resists Rift Saturation (+6% per piece); tools mine Vestige blocks 15% faster.
gui.relicweave.loom.reversible: Augments are reversible: removing one returns the base relic.
gui.relicweave.loom.insert_relic: Place a supported relic in the Relic slot.
gui.relicweave.loom.no_relic: Place a relic in the Relic slot.
gui.relicweave.loom.unsupported: This relic has no augment paths.
gui.relicweave.loom.nothing_to_remove: This relic has no augment to remove.
jei.relicweave.info.concordant_alloy: Craft 4 Aetherite Ingots with 1 boss component (Sovereign Thorn, Liminal Chord, Gravity Heart or Starforged Core) to get 2 Concordant Alloy. Alloy upgrades Netherite gear at a smithing table and repairs Aetherforged gear.
jei.relicweave.info.vestige_upgrade_temp: Upgrades Netherite gear into Aetherforged gear at a smithing table together with Concordant Alloy; enchantments and names are kept. Duplicate it with 7 diamonds and 1 Concordant Alloy (makes 2).
jei.relicweave.info.aetherforged: Smith Netherite gear with a Vestige Upgrade Template and Concordant Alloy. Aetherforged is a sidegrade: slightly more durability, toughness and enchantability. Perk: armor gives 6% Rift Saturation protection per piece, and tools mine Vestige blocks 15% faster.
jei.relicweave.info.reliquary_loom: Optional relic customization. Choose one of two augment paths for a supported relic, paying Mnemonic Filament and a path material. Augments are reversible: removing one returns the base relic.
